title: Status light timer tick (10s) and pane state evaluation
description: Set a 10-second repeating timer in MmuxApp that calls SessionTree.refresh_lights(). refresh_lights() walks all pane nodes, computes elapsed seconds since last Activity/Silence event, sets light to ● (<active_secs), ◎ (active_secs–silent_secs), or ○ (>silent_secs). Defaults: active_secs=30, silent_secs=300.

title: ENTER key attach flow: App.suspend() + ssh tmux attach
description: Bind ENTER to action_attach() in SessionTree. Get selected node's (host, session, pane). Build cmd=['ssh','-t',host,'tmux attach -t <session>']; if pane node, append '; select-pane -t <pane>'. Use 'with self.app.suspend(): subprocess.run(cmd)'. TUI resumes automatically after context exits.

title: Wire lifecycle events: add/remove SessionTree nodes
description: In MmuxApp's event consumer loop, handle SessionCreated/PaneCreated → add host/session/pane node to SessionTree. Handle SessionClosed/PaneClosed → mark node 'closed' (dim), schedule removal after 5 s via set_timer. State tracked in PaneState dict keyed (host, session, pane).

title: SessionTree widget: tree structure and status light rendering
description: Implement SessionTree(Tree) in mmux/tui.py. Node hierarchy: host → session → pane. Each node stores a PaneState(host, session, window, pane, last_activity_ts, last_silence_ts). Render label with right-aligned status light (● ◎ ○) and 'last: Xs ago' suffix. Use Rich markup for colors.

title: mmux.tui: Textual App shell with placeholder data
description: Create mmux/tui.py with MmuxApp(App) subclass. On compose(), build layout: header, SessionTree widget in center, footer with key hints. Populate tree with hardcoded mock data (2 hosts, 2 sessions each, 2 panes each) so layout can be iterated without a live stream.

title: mmux.install: core install() function (10 steps, idempotent)
description: Implement install(target, queue_path='~/.local/state/mmux') in mmux/install.py. Steps: (1) check existing install, (2) scp mmuxq to ~/.local/bin/, (3) write mmux-hook and mmux-claude-hook via SSH stdin, (4) mmuxq init queue/, (5) register tmux+claude producers saving .pmp files, (6) register consumer with cat hook, (7) touch events.jsonl, (8) mmuxq start, (9) load tmux global hooks, (10) merge Notification hook into ~/.claude/settings.json. All steps idempotent.

title: mmux-hook and mmux-claude-hook bash helper templates
description: Define the two helper scripts as string constants in mmux/install.py (or a resources file): mmux-hook (formats key=value args → JSONL via python3 -c, writes to PMP) and mmux-claude-hook (reads Claude JSON from stdin → JSONL, writes to PMP). Paths: ~/.local/bin/. PMP paths from ~/.local/state/mmux/{proto}.pmp.

title: mmux.queue: SSH tail-f line_stream async generator
description: Implement mmux/queue.py: line_stream(target) spawns 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes <target> tail -f -n +1 ~/.local/state/mmux/events.jsonl' via asyncio.create_subprocess_exec, yields stripped bytes lines, terminates process on cleanup. REMOTE_EVENTS_FILE constant.

title: mmux.protos.claude: Notification dataclass
description: Implement Notification(ts, message, session_id='') in mmux/protos/claude.py, registered as ('claude','Notification').

title: mmux.protos.tmux: all 6 dataclasses
description: Implement Activity, Silence, SessionCreated, SessionClosed, PaneCreated, PaneClosed in mmux/protos/tmux.py, each decorated with @register('tmux', '<ClassName>'). Fields per plan schema table. ts is Unix epoch seconds (float).

title: mmux.protos: registry, parse_line, events() async generator
description: Implement mmux/protos/__init__.py: REGISTRY dict, @register(proto, schema) decorator, parse_line(line) → dataclass | None (logs+skips unknown), events(target) async generator that calls queue.line_stream and yields parsed objects.

title: Phase 1: Proto layer and queue stream
description: Foundation layer: JSONL proto/schema registry, all tmux and claude dataclasses, and the SSH-based async event stream. Everything else depends on this.

title: Add Containerfile and @container script for podman dev environment
description: Create a Containerfile that installs claude code CLI, beads (bd), and uv for Python development. Create a @container bash/argc script with build and run subcommands.
close_reason: Containerfile and @container script created and verified; all three tools (claude, bd, uv) confirmed working inside container

title: mmux status CLI command
description: Add 'mmux status <target>...' Click command. For each target: SSH to check dispatcher state, count pending messages (find producers -type f | wc -l), read mtime of last line in events.jsonl. Print one-line summary per target.

title: Auto-install on connect
description: In mmux.queue.line_stream, before spawning tail -f, SSH-check for ~/.local/state/mmux/events.jsonl existence. If absent (or dispatcher not running), call mmux.install.install(target) automatically, then retry the stream. Surface install progress to TUI as a status message.

title: Notification log panel (toggle with 'l')
description: Add a collapsible RichLog panel at the bottom of MmuxApp. 'l' keybinding toggles visibility. All claude.Notification events are appended to this log with timestamp and message. Unmatched notifications are only visible here.
close_reason: RichLog panel already implemented in mmux-388.4 work

title: Claude Notification badge and footer bar
description: On claude.Notification event: attempt correlation to a pane by matching session_id substring against known tmux session names. If matched, add '[!]' badge to that pane's node label. Display notification message in a footer bar (RichLog or Label widget). If unmatched, route to the global notification log panel.

title: Manual smoke test: run mmux tui against a real remote
description: Acceptance: 'mmux tui localhost' launches, shows the SessionTree with live data, status lights update. Document any regressions found.
notes: Manual smoke test: run 'mmux tui localhost' after full install, verify SessionTree renders with live status lights. Requires human with a running tmux session.
close_reason: Manual smoke test deferred; requires human with live tmux+mmux install

title: mmux tui CLI command wired to live event stream
description: Add 'mmux tui [target]...' Click command in mmux/cli.py. Parses targets as [user@]host[:session]. If no targets, uses ['localhost']. Launches MmuxApp(targets=...).run(). App opens one asyncio task per target calling mmux.protos.events(target) and feeding events into the app via app.call_from_thread or worker.

title: Integration test: install to localhost, verify directory structure
description: pytest integration test (marked slow/integration): call install('localhost'), then assert ~/.local/state/mmux/queue/ exists, events.jsonl exists, dispatcher is running, tmux hooks are set, ~/.claude/settings.json has Notification hook entry. Teardown calls uninstall().

title: mmux install CLI command
description: Add 'mmux install [--queue-path PATH] <target>...' Click command in mmux/cli.py. Calls mmux.install.install() for each target. Prints progress steps.

title: Tests: queue line_stream with mock SSH subprocess
description: pytest-asyncio test: patch asyncio.create_subprocess_exec to return a mock process feeding canned bytes; assert line_stream yields expected stripped lines; assert process is terminated on generator close.

title: Tests: proto parsing from canned JSONL
description: pytest tests in tests/test_protos.py: feed canned JSONL bytes covering each schema, assert correct dataclass type and field values; assert None returned for unknown proto/schema and bad JSON.

title: Phase 4: TUI event handling
description: Wire lifecycle events into the tree, status light timer tick, ENTER-to-attach flow, Claude notification badges and log panel.

title: Phase 3: TUI skeleton
description: Textual app with SessionTree widget, status lights, and mmux tui CLI command wired to the live event stream.

title: Phase 2: Remote install
description: mmux install command and mmux.install module: copy mmuxq, init queue, register producers/consumer, install tmux hooks, patch ~/.claude/settings.json. Idempotent. Also mmux uninstall.

title: Multi-host visual grouping and 'r' reconnect key
description: Ensure SessionTree groups panes under host-level nodes with visual separators. Add 'r' keybinding: cancels all running event stream tasks and restarts them, showing a brief 'reconnecting…' status. Handles SSH drops gracefully (retry with exponential backoff up to 60s).

title: --active-secs and --silent-secs CLI options for mmux tui
description: Add --active-secs (default 30) and --silent-secs (default 300) integer options to 'mmux tui'. Pass values into MmuxApp and down to SessionTree.refresh_lights(). Config file values are defaults; CLI flags override.

title: Config file support (~/.config/mmux/config.toml)
description: Read XDG config from ~/.config/mmux/config.toml (or --config path). Support [defaults] active_secs, silent_secs, queue_path; [[targets]] list with host and sessions fields. CLI flags override config. Use tomllib (Python 3.11+) or tomli for parsing.

title: mmux uninstall CLI command
description: Add 'mmux uninstall [--purge] <target>...' Click command. Stops dispatcher, removes tmux hooks (set-hook -gu for each), removes Notification hook entry from ~/.claude/settings.json. With --purge removes ~/.local/state/mmux/ entirely.

title: Phase 5: Polish
description: Auto-install on connect, mmux status command, config file (~/.config/mmux/config.toml), --active-secs/--silent-secs options, multi-host grouping, reconnect key.
